Why Every Rainbow Is Really a Full 360° Circle! — We only draw half-arch rainbows—so where is the hidden bottom half hiding?
Kids science answer for "are rainbows full circles for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Every rainbow is actually a full 360-degree ring of sunlight bending through raindrops; from the ground, the Earth horizon blocks the bottom half.
